criteria.name: hospital_proximity
criteria.description: New facility should be far from existing hospitals to maximize spatial coverage of services

criteria.name: road_access
criteria.description: Site should be close to road network for accessibility

candidate_analysis.description: Identify contiguous regions of pixels scoring strictly above suitability_threshold, filter those meeting min_contiguous_area_ha, compute per-patch statistics

results_format.total_suitable_area_ha: float: total area in hectares of all pixels with suitability strictly > suitability_threshold, rounded to 2 decimal places
results_format.num_candidate_patches: integer: number of contiguous patches meeting minimum area requirement

best_candidate.patch_id: integer: 1-indexed ID of the highest mean_suitability patch
best_candidate.centroid_x: float: X coordinate (in analysis CRS) of the geometric centroid of the patch pixel centers, rounded to 1 decimal place
best_candidate.centroid_y: float: Y coordinate (in analysis CRS) of the geometric centroid of the patch pixel centers, rounded to 1 decimal place
best_candidate.area_ha: float: area of the patch in hectares, rounded to 2 decimal places
best_candidate.mean_suitability: float: mean suitability score within the patch, rounded to 2 decimal places

results_format.mean_suitability_all: float: arithmetic mean suitability across ALL valid (non-zero) pixels in the suitability raster, rounded to 2 decimal places

candidates_format.description: JSON array of objects, one per qualifying patch, sorted by mean_suitability descending

fields.patch_id: integer: 1-indexed patch identifier assigned after sorting
fields.centroid_x: float: X coordinate of geometric centroid of patch pixel centers in analysis CRS, rounded to 1 decimal place
fields.centroid_y: float: Y coordinate of geometric centroid of patch pixel centers in analysis CRS, rounded to 1 decimal place
fields.area_ha: float: patch area in hectares, rounded to 2 decimal places
fields.mean_suitability: float: mean suitability within patch, rounded to 2 decimal places
fields.max_suitability: float: maximum suitability pixel value within patch
